newsitem.title: UK: Eleco up after director share buying.
newsitem.headline: Eleco up after director share buying.

text.p: Shares in building materials group Eleco Holdings Plc jumped 17 percent on Tuesday after a press report highlighted recent director share purchases, dealers said.
As London trading resumed after Monday's public holiday, the stock was up 3-1/2p at 23-3/4 by 0906 GMT in volume of 325,909 shares.
The Sunday Times said Eleco chairman John Ketteley had recently increased his stake in the group and other directors had also bought shares in recent months.
The paper said an upturn in the housing market should boost the company's results this year, after it reported a pre-tax loss of 96,000 stg in the six months to December 1996.
